# Skill Icons

The tool strip in `assets/toolkit-dark.svg` and `assets/toolkit-light.svg` uses [tandpfun/skill-icons](https://github.com/tandpfun/skill-icons), under the included MIT license. Downloaded from skillicons.dev on 5 October 2026 with C++, Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Git.

The icons retain their original colours and light/dark backgrounds. They are stored locally as static SVG assets, so displaying the tool strip does not require a live external image API.
